prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.low.0: Hm. %1$s. Keep an eye on that one.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.low.2: Their kind never did fit in.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.low.4: Wouldn't want my daughter marrying a %1$s.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.0: Gods. A %1$s. Is that even a person?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.1: Hide the children, there's a %1$s about.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.2: Unnatural, that. Should keep to their own.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.3: Look at it. %1$s. Makes my skin crawl.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.4: Don't let it touch anything. %1$s filth.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.bio.0: Gods, it's one of the vat things. Don't let it near the well.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.bio.1: That's no person. That's something the Tinkerer grew.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.bio.2: I don't care what it's wearing, I know what's under it.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.bio.3: It eats people, you know. Swallows them whole.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.bio.4: Bar the door. The made thing's walking about.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.bio.5: Look at it move. Like it's wearing someone's shape.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.child.0: Mama, why does that one look like that?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.child.1: Is that a %1$s? Is it true they bite?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.child.3: Papa says not to talk to %1$s folk.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.shrink.2: Excuse me. I'll just... over here.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.0: Pay the stares no mind, %2$s. Blood's blood.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.1: Folk can be cruel to %1$s. Not me.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.2: Good day to you, %2$s. Don't let them sour it.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.3: I don't care what you're born. Welcome.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kin.0: Another %1$s. Chin up; they look at me the same.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kin.1: Ah, one of ours. Stick close to friends here, %2$s.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kin.2: %1$s and proud, eh? Let them stare.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.0: A human. Come to have a laugh at us, have you?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.1: We left your kind behind for a reason.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.2: Keep walking, human. Nobody stares at us here but you.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.3: Huh. See how it feels, being the odd one out?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.4: Watch that one. Humans never come here for anything good.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.0: Human. Bet you've laughed at folk like me.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.1: Hmph. Your lot never let us forget what we are.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.2: Go on, stare. Everyone else does.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.3: Humans. Always so sure they're the proper sort.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival_child.0: My mama says humans are mean.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival_child.2: Are you gonna laugh at how I look? Everyone does.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.fair.0: Not every human's the same, I suppose. Good day.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.fair.1: You've an honest face, %2$s. For a human.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.fair.2: Pay my kin's scowls no mind. They've had a hard time of it.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.0: Welcome, %2$s. No one stares at you here.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.1: A %1$s! Rest easy. You're among your own sort here.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.2: Tired of the human towns too? Most of us were.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.3: Stay as long as you like. We look after each other.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.0: My grandmother lived among the humans. Every day the jeering. One spring she packed up and came here, and never went back.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.1: We built this place ourselves. No humans to tell us what we are.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.2: In the human towns they charged us double and called it a kindness. Here a %1$s pays what anyone pays.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.3: They say there's more villages like ours every year. Folk get tired of being laughed at.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.4: Don't bring humans round here, %2$s. We came here to be rid of them.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.nonhuman: Heard of the villages where only our sort live? I think about going, some days.
The humans laugh at us here. Over in the havens, it's the other way round.
Every year a few more of us leave for the havens. Can't say I blame them.
Being a %1$s among humans is a lonely thing, %2$s.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.0: Did you hear? There's whole villages now with not one proper human in them.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.1: Those non-human villages want nothing to do with us. Good riddance, I say.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.2: My cousin went to trade with one of those haven places. They charged him double and stared him out of town.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.3: Bad blood between us and the non-humans these days. Mind yourself out on the roads.
